transfer_records_hint: Progress, counts and failure reasons of upgrades, copies and moves.
transfer_upgrade_hint: Create a team workspace and move all product research data from your personal workspace into it, so you can invite others. Your personal workspace stays, but this data is removed from it.
transfer_upgrade_in_progress: A data transfer is in progress in this workspace. You can upgrade after it finishes.
transfer_upgrade_loading: Counting the data in your personal workspace…
transfer_upgrade_preview_failed: Could not load the upgrade preview. Please try again later.
transfer_upgrade_moves_title: Moves to the new team workspace
transfer_upgrade_moves_empty: Your personal workspace has no product research data yet; the new team workspace starts empty.
transfer_upgrade_activation_notice: Credits do not move. The new team workspace needs an administrator to activate it or grant credits before the workbench can be used. You can still return to your personal workspace meanwhile.
transfer_upgrade_api_key_notice: API keys of the personal workspace keep working after the upgrade but will read empty data; switch to keys of the new team workspace.
transfer_upgrade_readonly_notice: Both workspaces are read-only while the transfer runs; you are switched to the new team workspace when it completes.
transfer_upgrade_reason_in_progress: Another data transfer is in progress. Wait for it to finish.
transfer_upgrade_reason_limit: You already own {count} team workspaces, the limit is {max}.
transfer_upgrade_reason_unknown: Upgrade is not available right now ({code}).
transfer_upgrade_confirm_check: I understand that the data moves out of my personal workspace, while credits, subscriptions, AI conversations, files, API keys and audit records stay there.
transfer_upgrade_failed: Could not start the upgrade. Please try again.
transfer_list_hint: Upgrades, copies and moves with this workspace as source or target, latest 50. Owners and admins see all records; other members see the ones they started.
transfer_detail_polling: In progress, refreshing every few seconds.
transfer_detail_readonly_banner: Transfer in progress: the workbench of both workspaces is read-only until it completes or rolls back.
transfer_detail_compensating_hint: Undoing the executed batches; both workspaces will be restored to their state before the transfer.
transfer_detail_compensated_hint: All executed batches were undone; both workspaces are back to their state before the transfer.
transfer_detail_upgrade_compensated_hint: The new team workspace was deleted; your personal workspace data is unchanged.
transfer_detail_completed_upgrade: Upgrade completed. Your data is now in the new team workspace.
transfer_detail_conflict_merge: Merged into the existing target record
transfer_detail_unmapped_hint: These references have no matching record in the target workspace and were removed or cleared by the transfer rules.
transfer_detail_quota_notice: About {calls} additional external collection calls per day are expected (threshold {threshold}).
transfer_action_retry_hint: Use when execution stopped or made no progress for a long time: it resumes from unfinished batches without repeating finished ones.
transfer_action_retry_running: Execution is still running; no need to resume.
transfer_cancel_dialog_body: Executed batches are undone in reverse order and both workspaces are restored; they stay read-only while undoing. A cancelled upgrade deletes the new team workspace. This cannot be reverted.
transfer_banner: A data transfer ({kind}) is in progress in this workspace; the workbench is read-only until it finishes.
transfer_group_config: Settings (nodes, brands, risk rules, scoring, suppliers, logistics, cost parameters)
transfer_error_permission_revoked: Permissions changed during execution (a member was removed or demoted); the transfer was stopped and rolled back.
transfer_error_timeout: Execution did not finish within 30 minutes and was rolled back.
transfer_error_target_not_empty: The target workspace already has data that cannot be merged (such as accuracy audits).
transfer_error_entitlement_exceeded: The incoming data exceeds the target workspace's plan limits.
transfer_error_too_large: Too much data selected. Narrow the selection and try again.
transfer_error_closure_incomplete: Some references point to data that was not transferred and could not be mapped.
transfer_error_state: The transfer state changed. Refresh and try again.
transfer_error_compensation_order: Rollback order is inconsistent. Contact an administrator.
transfer_error_forbidden: You do not have the permission required for this transfer.
transfer_error_in_progress: A related workspace already has a data transfer in progress.
transfer_error_idempotency_conflict: Request conflict. Close the dialog and start again.
transfer_error_same_workspace: Source and target must be different workspaces.
transfer_error_unavailable: Background jobs are unavailable right now. Please try again later.
